name: ECOT - Eukyre's Consortium of Things
teaser: Home of the Blahaj and the FNX-45.
description:
Overview

ECOT (or, Eukyre’s Consortium of Things) is an all-in-one mod in which I will be adding most of my future content that isn’t set-up for Echoes of Tarkov, or my other standalone mods; as such, you can expect to find a wide variety of items in this mod, from Glocks to specific Shark Plushies (Yes, they’re back.)

THIS MOD REQUIRES EPIC’S ALL IN ONE TO WORK.

You have alerted the shork.

Balance Changes

This mod features a handful of vanilla item rebalances, mostly to do with items added alongside them, those being:

  • Re-adding .336 TKM AP-M to Mechanic LL3
  • Removing the proprietary stats from the Red SI ARE Buffer Tube

Once more balance changes are made, I will be adding a config with an option to disable the rebalances.

Install

Planned

Currently, the following items are planned additions:
- AR-15 STC Tactical “Valentine” muzzle brake
- Rugged Obsidian 9x19 suppressor
- MPR45 Offset BUIS mount (Specifically for Canted Iron Sights)

- Browning Hi-Power 9x19 pistol

- Smith & Wesson M&P 9x19 pistol

Gallery

Credits

Massive thank you to the amazing team I’m glad to now be a part of, WTT; particularly EpicRangeTime, for teaching me how to make assets and texture; Tron for the SP Smart Materials and other texture assistance; and Groovey for making the codebase that this mod runs on. Thank you, guys!

Check out the WTT Discord server here.

If you want to, you can support my work on my Ko-Fi page, found here.

dependencies.name: Epic's All in One
dependencies.teaser: An all in one expansion of the weapons and weapon parts of the game complete with the Badger trader.

versions.description:
Please delete the previous version of the mod before updating! There have been changes in the file paths so files will be left over if you just replace the old mod with the new one!

Remastered tons of items with new textures and shaders! Deduplicated a ton of assets, so despite adding a bunch of stuff the mod size actually went DOWN! Rebalanced the magnification and sensitivity of all scopes in the mod to a standard base. They are all standardized across the board now, if it’s different than BSG’s magnification then I don’t care.

Added:

  • Leupold CQBSS 1-8x Scope
  • Leupold MK5HD 5-25x (Mil FDE) Scope
  • Leupold MK5HD 3.6-18x Scope (Black and FDE)
  • Trijicon Accupower 1-8x Scope
  • Vortex Eleanor 1-10x Scope (Both FDE and Black)
  • Nightforce ATACR F1 1-8x Scope
  • Nightforce ATACR 4-16x Scope
  • Nightforce ATACR 4-20x Scope
  • Kahles K624i 6-24x Scope
  • FDE X-15 5.56 Mag
  • New Daniel Defense RIS II rails
  • KAC 7 Rib rail panel
  • Daniel Defense picatinny rail cover
  • Wilson Combat Starburst pistol grip
  • BCM Gunfighter Mod3 pistol grip

Fixed:

  • Lasers, in general
  • Scope masking, in general
  • Scar rear sight not appearing on scar uppers
  • AK-15 stock compat with new AKs
  • Magnfiiers eye relief

The Wilcox RAID-XE does not work in this version as I am awaiting a new model for it, not happy with the current one.

Enjoy!

Fixed:

  • Black vis OTAL laser selector missing texture
  • Wolverine suppressor attaching to gas block on AKS-74
  • Iron sights not conflicting with magnifiers
  • A few quests using the incorrect data type for some conditions

Added:

  • Gun quest rewards for some badger quests

This build has been blessed by the Omnissiah (debug pending).

Fixed a few pink textures, if there’s more it’s the machine spirit’s fault.

Fixed:

  • AK handguard bundles (that were working before and magically broke) are no longer broken

Yes I know we skipped a few minor versions, no big deal.

Fixes:

  • Fixed M4 carry handle issues everywhere (Thanks Bushtail)
  • Added Russian and Chinese locales (Thank you Akame, Evgeniy)
  • Updated URX3 textures
  • Remastered AK handguards
  • Remastered Geissele Mk4 and Mk16 handguards
  • Removed a few unused IDs (Thanks Archangel)
  • Renamed a few assets here and there to differentiate between backported items and mine.

Added:

  • Steiner Dbal D2
  • “Castle Doctrine” quest for badger

This is a release for SPT 4.0.3 This mod now requires the WTT-CommonLib version 2.0.0 or greater

  • Added more B5 bravo stocks
  • Fixed normals on the MK8 handguards
  • Squashed misc other reported bugs (I forgor which)

Enjoy!

• Fixed M157 Scope locales (Thanks Dandy!)

versions.description:
• added questhelper
  • force image cache if using fika because of local headless skill issue

Fixed Fika loading issue with icons!

  • added new ImageManager that works similar to spt’s BundleManager, creating a cache of icons and textures if needed
reduced the error logging to be behind config. MODDERS THAT USE COMMONLIB - ENABLE ITEM DEBUGGING IN THE CONFIG AND FIX YOUR SHIT

• FINALLY fixed salvage zones :prayge:
  • salvage zone UI update + icon!
  • add random craft result amount options
  • initialized buyrestrictioncurrent for traderhelper barters (ty for the detailed bug report!)
  • added client handling for random craft amounts
  • added better validation warnings and a config for validation logging
  • added fixplugintypesserialization patcher (thank you tarkin ❤️)
  • added new quest service for making quest items
  • removed dependency on spt customitemservice

HOTFIX NUMBER 2 FOR THE DAY REEEEEEE

  • fixed caliberhelper from being completely broken. PLEASE DOWNLOAD THIS VERSION IF YOU UPDATED TODAY.

• added weapon mod quest helper method
  • added CustomDialogueService for custom NPC Dialogues
  • changed CaliberHelper to process deferred like modslots (should allow for better compatibility for ammo)
  • fixed custom modslot images becoming blurry on low texture settings (Thanks Pein!)
added helper method for dogtag quests

Version so good it jumped a number!

  • new hideout crafting expansion by pein, now supports multi-endproducts and endproducts with nested children
  • reworked custom parent mapping into a server service + client attribute (also by pein)
  • separated logic in the slothelper methods, added a new one

• added new itemservice helper for adding items to blacklist
  • fixed nuget package forcibly including the en.json locale for the salvage zones in your project /bonk
  • fixed slothelper method and added support for creating new slot info
• fixed hideout crafts service not supporting anything but arrays /bonk

• Added new helper to slothelper to add ids by name
  • Added fix custom item sort order patch (thanks Pein! ❤ )
  • Added new “Salvage” zones to possible quest types
  • Added locales for the salvage zone interactions
  • Fixed hideout crafts not supporting .jsonc /bonk

• Implemented random loot container support for customitemserviceextended
  • Added save method to confighelper
• fixed questhelper adding to empty weapon conditions (specifically a punisher part 4 issue)

REMOVE ANY INSTANCE OF ECOT BEFORE UPDATING TO THIS VERSION.

Epic’s AIO is now a dependency due to the SANDMAN-S suppressor, sorry. :/

Squashed some bugs that were reported by the community. Thanks for the reports, guys!

  • Fixed the mod’s nesting (Now SPT>user>mods>EukyreECOT.)
  • New Adaptiv Defense URR rails for the AR-15 platform
  • New EOTech EXPS3-DCR with custom reticle.
  • Fixed collisions for the STANAG replacement mag.
  • Removed unused ‘CustomHideoutRecipes’ function that was printing a warning on load.
  • Removed leftover IDs from the 3.11 Creedmoor Remaster mod that were causing errors with another mod.
  • General Bundle updates across the board.

Man, this one’s been a long time coming, so long that I decided to skip a version tag, lol.

I’ve been working on this version ever since V1.1 came out all the way back in July! This update adds nearly 200+ new items; I can’t even realistically make a list for this.

There is some rebalancing for existing items, too. Mostly just new recoil stats for the rechambers and other things akin to that; basically just trying to make everything fit better in the world.

If I had unlimited time (which i basically did; I’m already kind of pushing it given that it’s been like 6 months,) I would’ve gone back and remastered every single item in this mod, because we very recently picked up a new texture workflow. but that would’ve added a solid month or two more onto this project.
